g.text: The amplifier supply units use P15 and N15 with local 100n and 4.7u capacitors.

g.desc: The amplifier supply units use P15 and N15 with local 100n and 4.7u capacitors.

g.text: DAC supply bypassing is grouped beside each converter. Keep these associations

g.desc: DAC supply bypassing is grouped beside each converter. Keep these associations

g.text: when placing the PCB so that every package has a short supply return.

g.desc: when placing the PCB so that every package has a short supply return.

g.text: BL_DAC_RAW0-31 feed the noninverting inputs of the OPA4192 followers. Two

g.desc: BL_DAC_RAW0-31 feed the noninverting inputs of the OPA4192 followers. Two

g.text: quad amplifiers serve each eight-channel group. Their feedback is local, and

g.desc: quad amplifiers serve each eight-channel group. Their feedback is local, and

g.text: each output reaches its BL_DAC net through a 4.7 ohm series resistor. These

g.desc: each output reaches its BL_DAC net through a 4.7 ohm series resistor. These

g.text: resistors separate the amplifier output from the downstream switch network.

g.desc: resistors separate the amplifier output from the downstream switch network.

g.text: Four AD5676R DACs provide all 32 bit-line setpoints. U1000 serves channels

g.desc: Four AD5676R DACs provide all 32 bit-line setpoints. U1000 serves channels

g.text: 0-7, U1003 serves 8-15, U1006 serves 16-23 and U1009 serves 24-31. Each

g.desc: 0-7, U1003 serves 8-15, U1006 serves 16-23 and U1009 serves 24-31. Each

g.text: device has its own CS_BL0-3 selection and shares the serial bus, LDAC and

g.desc: device has its own CS_BL0-3 selection and shares the serial bus, LDAC and

g.text: The DAC analog supply is ANA5, while its logic interface uses IO3V3. GAIN is tied

g.desc: The DAC analog supply is ANA5, while its logic interface uses IO3V3. GAIN is tied

g.text: to IO3V3 and RSTSEL to GND on each DAC. The reference pins have local bypass

g.desc: to IO3V3 and RSTSEL to GND on each DAC. The reference pins have local bypass

g.text: capacitors. Firmware must use these fixed hardware settings when converting a

g.desc: capacitors. Firmware must use these fixed hardware settings when converting a

g.text: requested voltage into a DAC code.

g.desc: requested voltage into a DAC code.

g.text: BL_DAC0-31 are voltage sources for the bit-line routing circuit, rather than

g.desc: BL_DAC0-31 are voltage sources for the bit-line routing circuit, rather than

g.text: permanent connections to the socket. The corresponding MAT_BL_VMM mask

g.desc: permanent connections to the socket. The corresponding MAT_BL_VMM mask

g.text: determines which buffered source is connected. A disabled switch allows the

g.desc: determines which buffered source is connected. A disabled switch allows the

g.text: same bit line to be grounded or used by the service route.

g.desc: same bit line to be grounded or used by the service route.
